action_instruction: Reading the exchange rate and spread note
intent: the displayed USD-to-INR exchange rate and its currency conversion spread note in the conversion review

action_params.condition: "Exchange rate" reads "1 USD = 81.54 INR" with the note about a 2% spread on 83.20.
action_params.query: the displayed USD-to-INR exchange rate and its currency conversion spread note in the conversion review
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rate = el(8).querySelector('[data-testid="cc-rate"]')?.textContent.trim(); const note = [...el(8).querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Includes a 2% currency conversion spread on the mid-market rate of 83.20.')?.textContent.trim(); return rate && note ? `${rate} ${note}` : null; })()

output_value: 1 USD = 81.54 INR Includes a 2% currency conversion spread on the mid-market rate of 83.20.
